method: validate.sh recomputes D=log2(sum S_prefix/sum S_strict) per (n,l,seed) straight from sessions/*/records.jsonl (measured, non-warmup rounds, cost.s) and pools by mean over seeds then cells; the claim comes from ecbench compare (summary/pairs.tsv) via pool.sh
independence_basis: Not independent: validate.sh was written and run by the same agent that produced the result. The coordinating session re-ran it and got the same 2.1055, which is a reproduction with the producer's script, not an independent validation. An independent validator (separate reviewer, own script) is still owed before any row is admitted.
